profile.name: Monkey D. Luffy

reasons.reason: Usar Skill 1 ativa traits; o perfil aumenta moderadamente a prioridade da sua recarga.

evidence.text: For a set period of time after using Skill 1: Resist Stagger, being Downed, and Knockback. and Remove status effects and nullify status effects inflicted by enemy.

reasons.reason: Há benefícios condicionados a HP acima de um limite; recuperação e manutenção de HP recebem prioridade adicional.

evidence.text: When your HP is 50% or more: Boost capture speed by 50%. and Remove status effects and nullify status effects inflicted by enemy.
When your HP is 30% or more: Reduce damage received by 30%. and 1 HP will be left even if KO'd (ineffective if HP is exactly 1).

reasons.reason: Capturar tesouro ativa traits. O perfil considera esse benefício além da classe.

evidence.text: When you capture the Treasure: Recover HP by 30%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 20%.

reasons.reason: O trait usa ATK no lugar de DEF ao receber dano. Isso orienta traits adicionais, mas não permite converter ATK em redução de dano sem simulação.

evidence.text: Can ignore the enemy and capture the Treasure. and Damage received from enemies is based on your ATK rather than your DEF (immune to the ability to disregard DEF)

stat_advice: Priorize avaliar ATK nos traits adicionais: este personagem usa ATK no lugar de DEF ao receber dano. O ranking abaixo não presume traits equipados.
profile.confidence: perfil com regras de traits reconhecidas

unmodeled.text: Nullifies Shock and Entrance. and Recover 50% of percentage damage received from an enemy.

After holding down the normal attack button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo and the 2nd hit of the attack changes: the character either transforms into or out of the Gum-Gum Giant form.
When changing into the Gum-Gum Giant form: Increase ATK by 30% for 20 seconds. (Cannot Stack).
This character cannot change into the Gum-Gum Giant form when in areas that Big Characters cannot enter.
When attacked by a character type "Navy" enemy: Remove enemy's ATK increase. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 5%.
Can capture Treasure from a certain area outside the Treasure Area (unless there is a large difference in elevation) and Can capture Treasure without moving to the center of the Treasure Area.
The 3rd hit of a normal attack combo deals damage at the enemy's feet.
When you start capturing the enemy's Treasure: Transform the Treasure Area where you are at into Gum-Gum Treasure Area.

Gum-Gum Treasure Areas can unleash an area attack that deals damage (200 Power) with a chance to inflict Tremor (Short) for 3 seconds. The Gum-Gum transformation will disappear after you capture Treasure, when interrupted while capturing Treasure, or after you are KO'd.
When performing a Perfect Guard, deals a mid-range area attack that inflicts Stagger.
When performing a Perfect Guard: Recover HP by 30%. and Reduce the cooldown time of guard by 100%.
While you are capturing Treasure: Resist Stagger and being Downed.
When Respawned: Increase the cooldown time of your Skill 1 by 50% and SPD: Boosted by 30% for 10 second(s). (Cannot Stack)
When attacked by an enemy using a skill: Reduce damage received by 50%. and Recover HP by 5%.
After receiving damage from an enemy which is less than or equal to 20% of your max HP: resist Stagger.

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Condições usam os fatores gerais 0,5 e 0,25; o cenário real pode mudar a ordem.
Os cinco sets podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
